A [[Color/Legends|blue]] '''EG-6 power droid''' roamed the courtyard of the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]. It was several hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.<ref name="SWCL" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Kenner Products|Kenner]] released a "Power Droid" action figure in [[1978]].<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|pack=Power Droid|link=VINtPowerdroid.asp}}</ref> While the photo on the package is of a [[Unidentified EG-6 power droid (Tatooine)|droid]] found inside the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa's]] [[Digger crawler|sandcrawler]] in {{Film|IV}}, it's design and coloring more closely resembles this droid.<ref name="ANH" />
